title: Line sketch: Melancholy Demon Mask
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: The artwork centers on a stylized horned face with closed eyes and a downturned mouth, rendered in flat tones against a background. Bold black outlines and subtle accents define the ears, snout, and facial contours, creating a graphic, mask-like portrait. The composition emphasizes curved shapes and minimal detail for an expressive, symbolic effect (derived from painting #161).
